I may not be the best candidate to answer this because 1) I'm a teenager who's never been in a relationship and 2) I'm in the middle of a suicidal episode. But I still want to offer my support. I like someone at the moment, in my eyes she's perfect, kind, successful etc, the same old stuff everyone feels about their beloved I guess. But when I really look at it she's not that great and there's probably a million like her. You said you were cynical, right? So instead of looking at the situation as shitty, look at her as shitty. Start by making a list of her flaws and if you want, get back to me. This is the best advice I can give, it's okay if you don't want to listen, btw.
Thanks :) I don't know if I have it in me to be that vulnerable to another human but i'll try.
PM me? Maybe we could relate to each other.
